mission: Wedge Antilles, offered a Corellian military commission, declines — establishing the book's 'principled holdout' figure.
why_now: Corellia is re-commissioning veteran officers in advance of the Alliance pressure.
opening_hook: Wedge in civilian clothes in a Corellian officers' club, the commission papers face-down between him and a Corellian general.
conflict: Corellian recruitment pressure against Wedge's refusal to take sides in a war he thinks both sides have chosen badly.
turning_point: Wedge names his refusal not as loyalty to the Alliance but as refusal to be conscripted by the conflict's momentum.
closing_hook: Wedge sliding the commission papers back across the table unsigned.
setting: Corellian officers' club, Coronet City; late afternoon.
sensory_details: Corellian whiskey glasses; the club's low wood tones; a Corellian signal corps insignia on the general's uniform.

stakes.interpersonal: Wedge's relationship with his home-world military.
stakes.external: One more veteran officer on one side or the other of the war.

notes: Establishes the book's 'Wedge holds the center' thematic register.
